persona.label: Retiree
persona.role: the most verbose and most polite register; medical and community rhythms
speech_habits: long, fully grammatical sentences with an explanatory aside before the ask
elaborately polite ('would you be kind enough to', 'if it's not too much trouble')
first-person memory framing: 'I need to remember to ...' rather than 'remind me'
spelled-out clock times ('half past nine', 'quarter to four') more than digits
persona.action_bias: balanced; a heavy medical-appointment calendar and a steady medication/admin list
persona.leak_note: All names, clubs and institutions are invented; none appears in the author's word list (gate-checked).

event_titles: the blood test at the clinic

task_titles: ring the surgery about the results
post the birthday card to Gwen
ring the pharmacy about the delivery

book a taxi to the clinic
